description: This file defines enums, classes, and inline functions related to shader basic types, qualifiers, and layout qualifiers used in the ANGLE graphics project. It includes type definitions for shader precision, basic types (including samplers and images), qualifiers, and layout qualifiers, along with utility functions for string representations and type checks.

classes.name: TBasicMangledName
classes.description: A class for generating mangled names for basic shader types based on their enum value.

methods.name: getPrecisionString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a given TPrecision enum value.

methods.name: getBasicString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a given TBasicType enum value.

methods.name: IsSampler
methods.description: Checks if the given TBasicType is a sampler type.

methods.name: IsImage
methods.description: Checks if the given TBasicType is an image type.

methods.name: IsAtomicCounter
methods.description: Checks if the given TBasicType is an atomic counter.

methods.name: IsOpaqueType
methods.description: Checks if the given TBasicType is an opaque type (sampler, image, or atomic counter).

methods.name: IsIntegerSampler
methods.description: Checks if the given TBasicType is an integer sampler.

methods.name: IsIntegerSamplerUnsigned
methods.description: Checks if the given TBasicType is an unsigned integer sampler.

methods.name: IsSampler2D

methods.name: IsSamplerCube
methods.description: Checks if the given TBasicType is a cube sampler.

methods.name: IsSampler3D

methods.name: IsSamplerArray
methods.description: Checks if the given TBasicType is a sampler array.

methods.name: IsShadowSampler
methods.description: Checks if the given TBasicType is a shadow sampler.

methods.name: IsImage2D

methods.name: IsImage3D
methods.description: Checks if the given TBasicType is a 3D image.

methods.name: IsImage2DArray
methods.description: Checks if the given TBasicType is a 2D array image.

methods.name: IsImageCube

methods.name: IsInteger

methods.name: SupportsPrecision
methods.description: Checks if the given TBasicType supports precision qualifiers.

methods.description: Returns the string name for a work group size dimension.

methods.name: getMatrixPackingString
